mathematical_definition: spread.diff(1) -- bar-over-bar change in quoted spread
numerical_stability_notes: live_compatible=false: MarketState's bounded live buffer (built in an earlier phase of this project) does not retain per-bar spread history -- only the current live tick's instantaneous spread, plus small tick-level ring buffers a later, different family (Task 21) will use for live spread dynamics. There is no prior M1 bar's spread available live to diff against, so this feature genuinely cannot run from the live engine's bounded window as implemented; Task 21's live-tick spread family replaces it for live use (spec section 7).
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first bar, never zero-filled
status_reason: Not a v3 survivor (research/output/v3_feature_survivors.json): catboost_importance=0.000 (<0.3), MI rank 115 (outside top 15). catboost_importance=0.0, cv_importance=0.0, mi_rank=115, family=H_microstructure.
